Our troops deserve real, nutritious food.

Secretary Kennedy is bringing the MAHA movement to our military bases and making sure our servicemembers have access to better food and better nutrition.

Our military asks the best of our men and women in uniform. We should give them the fuel they need to perform at their best.

Healthy troops are stronger troops. Stronger troops are mission-ready troops.

Feed our military like the warriors they are.

Make America Healthy Again.

Your boss and your roommate should never be the same person.

It's inappropriate, it's a conflict of interest, and it should have been banned decades ago. We introduced a resolution to prohibit any Member of Congress from living with a House employee, unless the employee is the Member's spouse.

Shockingly, there is no rule against this today. We've seen it happen. Our resolution puts a stop to it.
